messages:
sam (AE): Quick thread to capture the SwitchBoard migration asks. They want a tight presales packet: POC scope, parity checklist, cost delta, security answers, and a rollback plan. Can we align here?
anya (SE): I can run parity. Plan: 4-day POC: day1 spike, day2 adapter + tests, day3 replay, day4 analysis. Tests: 30 canonical prompts, 20 edge cases (stop-seq, streaming chunks, multi-turn). Enable n=3 and preserve per-token logprobs.
pablo (SRE): Options: hosted pinned to eu-west-1 or Dedicated inside their VPC. If they need fixed egress IPs we must provision static NATs. Provide their infra contact for routing.
hannah (Pricing): I'll draft three price paths: PAYG hosted, 12-mo commit, Dedicated commit. Also show estimated savings from batching + KV cache for their workload.
nora (Security): Received their 38-question security form. I can fill standard items but need owners for encryption key lifecycle and data-retention policy. They require DPA + regional data-flow diagram.
legal-bot: Note: BYOK requests affect hosted deliverability. Dedicated supports customer-managed keys with HSM but requires 3-4 week lead time and PS work.
sam (AE): They use VendorXs top-5 rerank flow: VendorX returns 5 candidates, they rerank externally. Want compatibility so they can reuse reranker.
anya (SE): We'll expose choices[] + logprobs and provide a small adapter library mapping VendorX fields to Redwood fields. Pseudo: 
```
resp = redwood.generate(model="r-main-1", prompt=p, n=5)
adapted = [{"text": c.text, "logprob": c.logprob, "tokens": c.tokens} for c in resp.choices]
return {"choices": adapted, "meta": {"model": resp.model}}
```
anya (SE): Parity gotchas: tokenization differences, stop-sequence precedence (VendorX treats stop as hard trim), trailing whitespace, and streaming chunk boundaries. We'll add unit tests to assert exact byte-level matches on their sample outputs.
pablo (SRE): For the sandbox replay we need sample payloads, desired qps, and a list of IPs to allowlist. We'll preserve x-request-id and add x-compat-ratelimit headers for vendor parity.
nora (Security): Blocker: Catalyst requires EU residency and BYOK for EU data. Hosted pinned to eu-west-1 without BYOK is not acceptable for them. Flagging as hard constraint.
hannah (Pricing): If BYOK required, add PS integration + 4-week lead + one-time setup fee. I'll model the delta and include 12/36mo discount tiers.
sam (AE): Rollback plan they requested: keep VendorX endpoint active until cutover, DNS TTL change window, smoke tests, and verification checklist. Legal wants simple liability language for the POC.
legal-bot: I'll draft a short SLA addendum for Dedicated: 99.9% uptime and a p95 latency target; remedies capped to credits. Need approval from contracts.
anya (SE): Deliverables for POC: 1) adapter shim + source, 2) parity test suite and results, 3) replay logs + latency CSV, 4) mapping doc for fields differences.
pablo (SRE): Tentative schedule: Fri get prompts + sample outputs, Mon provision sandbox, Tue replay, Wed parity report. Need IP allowlist 24h before replay.
nora (Security): I'll attach SOC2 artifact and start answering the questionnaire today. Need product owner for retention answers.
hannah (Pricing): Draft quote link: https://redwood.app/sales/quotes/SW-721 (will update after we see token mix).
sam (AE): Action items: 1) Catalyst to send prompt set + problem outputs, 2) Anya to run parity and ship adapter, 3) Nora to complete security Q, 4) Hannah to finalize quote, 5) Pablo to schedule replay. Flag blockers now. :mag:
